item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00073","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C03","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. C11 shares the security-program and budget-amendment context but not the child's transmittal structure as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"supplemental estimates of appropriation ... for the fiscal year 1949 for the National Military Establishment, in the form of amendments to the Budget","parent_excerpt":"detailed estimates for additional appropriations ... for the Military Establishment for the fiscal year 1949 ... will soon be submitted to the Congress","explanation":"C22 anticipates the very military appropriation estimates transmitted by the child and supplies the same fiscal-year, institution, and congressional-submission framework."},{"child_excerpt":"to carry out the purposes indicated in my address to the Congress on March 17, 1948","parent_excerpt":"In my address to the Congress on March 17, 1948 ... a limited increase in our national security program is required","explanation":"Both directives expressly anchor the requested military resources in the same presidential address and national-security program."},{"child_excerpt":"The details of these estimates, the necessity therefor, and the reasons for their submission at this time are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I concur.","parent_excerpt":"The details of this proposed provision, the necessity therefor, and the reason for its submission at this time are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I concur.","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim transmittal language and constitutes direct evidence of reusable drafting."}]}
